customer_id.meaning: Primary id of the patient profile (content hash or seed id); every holding and event row of the patient carries it.

full_name.meaning: Patient's legal full name exactly as registered on the profile, matching the patient's government ID.

patient_number.meaning: Larkspur patient number printed in the app and on statements, format LH- followed by 7 digits (e.g. LH-4829137); a verification credential.

date_of_birth.meaning: Patient's date of birth as registered; used for identity verification and for every age-based rule (age is counted in completed years on the relevant date).

phone.meaning: Registered mobile phone number of the patient; a verification credential.

email.meaning: Registered email address of the patient, lower case; a verification credential.

home_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the patient's registered home address; a verification credential.

home_state.meaning: State of the patient's registered home address; this is the residence state, not necessarily where the patient is located during a visit.

profile_opened_date.meaning: Date the patient profile was created at Larkspur Health.

membership_id.meaning: Primary id of the consumer membership record.

customer_id.meaning: Patient who holds the membership (foreign key -> customers).

variant_name.meaning: Membership tier currently held, written as the official full tier name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the membership (basis defined in the membership charter lifecycle).

enrolled_date.meaning: Date the patient enrolled in this membership.

activated_date.meaning: Date the membership first became active (first paid period start, or trial conversion date); empty until activated.

trial_end_date.meaning: Date the free trial ends and the first dues are charged; empty when the enrollment carried no trial.

current_period_start.meaning: First day of the billing period currently paid for.

current_period_end.meaning: Next billing date; the current period runs from current_period_start up to but not including this date.

membership_year_start.meaning: Start of the current membership year (the activation anniversary); annual limits and caps reset on this date.

auto_renew.meaning: Whether the membership renews automatically at current_period_end.

pause_start_date.meaning: First day of the most recent pause; empty if never paused.

pause_end_date.meaning: Date the most recent pause ends and service resumes; empty if never paused.

cancelled_date.meaning: Date the membership became cancelled; empty while not cancelled.

suspended_date.meaning: Date the membership most recently became suspended; empty if never suspended.

primary_clinician.meaning: Name of the dedicated primary care clinician assigned to the member, as shown in the app (e.g. 'Dr. Priya Raman, MD'); empty when none is assigned.

clinician_assigned_date.meaning: Date the current primary clinician was assigned; empty when none is assigned.

credit_balance.meaning: Unused account credit on this membership; always equals credits issued minus credits applied and expired.

enrollment_channel.meaning: Channel through which the membership was enrolled; employer_conversion marks a conversion from a Larkspur at Work enrollment.

referred_by_customer_id.meaning: Patient whose referral link was used at enrollment (foreign key -> customers); empty when not referred.

mem_charge_id.meaning: Primary id of the membership billing line.

event_type.meaning: Billing line type, taken verbatim from the membership charter events.

amount.meaning: Gross amount of the line before any account credit is applied; charges are positive, refunds and chargebacks negative; a failed attempt records the amount attempted (positive) and moves no money.

charge_date.meaning: Date the line was posted (charge, attempt, refund or chargeback date).

period_start.meaning: First day of the billing or pause period the line pays for (for refunds and chargebacks, the period of the original charge).

period_end.meaning: End (exclusive) of the billing or pause period the line pays for.

tier_charged.meaning: Membership tier whose price the line was computed from.

attempt_number.meaning: For membership_payment_failed, the attempt sequence number within the same period (1 = original attempt); 1 for every other line.

original_charge_id.meaning: For refunds and chargebacks, the billing line being reversed (foreign key -> membership_charges.mem_charge_id); for failed attempts and every charge, empty.

refund_reason.meaning: Basis of a refund line; none for every non-refund line.

mem_credit_id.meaning: Primary id of the account-credit line.

membership_id.meaning: Membership whose credit balance the line moves (foreign key -> membership_holdings).

event_type.meaning: Credit line type, taken verbatim from the membership charter events.

amount.meaning: Credit amount moved, always positive; issued lines add to credit_balance, applied and expired lines subtract.

credit_date.meaning: Date the credit was issued, applied or expired.

credit_reason.meaning: Why the original credit was issued; applied and expired lines repeat the reason of the credit they draw down.

source_credit_id.meaning: For applied and expired lines, the issued credit drawn down (foreign key -> membership_credits.mem_credit_id); empty on issued lines.

applied_charge_id.meaning: For applied lines, the dues or proration line the credit paid toward (foreign key -> membership_charges.mem_charge_id); empty otherwise.

referred_customer_id.meaning: For referral credits, the referred patient whose first paid dues earned the credit (foreign key -> customers); empty otherwise.

related_visit_id.meaning: For goodwill credits, the visit appointment cancelled by Larkspur that the credit compensates (foreign key -> visit_appointments); empty otherwise.

expiry_date.meaning: Date an issued credit expires if not used; repeated on applied and expired lines.

mem_notice_id.meaning: Primary id of the membership notice record.

membership_id.meaning: Membership the notice concerns (foreign key -> membership_holdings).

event_type.meaning: Notice type, taken verbatim from the membership charter events.

period_start.meaning: Start date of the renewal period (or trial conversion date) the notice announces.

channel.meaning: Channel the notice was sent through; one record per channel.

mem_request_id.meaning: Primary id of the membership change request.

customer_id.meaning: Patient making the request (foreign key -> customers).

membership_id.meaning: Membership the request concerns (foreign key -> membership_holdings).

requested_date.meaning: Date the patient made the request.

effective_date.meaning: Date the change takes effect under the membership charter.

target_variant_name.meaning: Tier the membership moves to for upgrade, downgrade and cycle_switch requests; empty string otherwise.

pause_months.meaning: Number of whole months requested for a pause; 0 for other request types.

request_status.meaning: pending until the effective date, applied once the change took effect, withdrawn if the patient withdrew it first.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

enrollment_id.meaning: Primary id of the Larkspur at Work enrollment record.

customer_id.meaning: Patient covered by the enrollment (foreign key -> customers).

values: Larkspur at Work Virtual Urgent Care
Larkspur at Work Core with Behavioral Health
Larkspur at Work Total Care Plus
variant_name.meaning: Larkspur at Work plan the employer has chosen for this enrollment, as the official full plan name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the enrollment (basis defined in the sponsor charter lifecycle).

employer_name.meaning: Employer's legal name as shown on the enrollment (e.g. 'Harbor Freight Logistics, LLC').

employer_group_number.meaning: Larkspur at Work group number of the employer, format LW- followed by 5 digits (e.g. LW-20417).

member_relationship.meaning: Relationship of the covered patient to the employee subscriber.

subscriber_customer_id.meaning: The employee subscriber's patient profile (foreign key -> customers); equals customer_id for the employee.

registered_date.meaning: Date the patient registered in the app under the employer group.

eligibility_effective_date.meaning: Effective date of eligibility stated on the employer's eligibility record.

coverage_start_date.meaning: First day the enrollment covers the patient; empty while not yet determined.

coverage_end_date.meaning: Last day the enrollment covers the patient (inclusive); empty while coverage is open-ended.

termination_reason.meaning: Why coverage ended or will end; none while no end is set.

plan_year_start.meaning: First day of the employer's current plan year; plan-year limits reset on this date.

leave_start_date.meaning: First day of the employee's current approved leave of absence; empty when not on leave.

contribution_method.meaning: How the patient's monthly contribution is collected: payroll deduction, or direct bill during a leave of absence.

contribution_id.meaning: Primary id of the contribution line.

enrollment_id.meaning: Enrollment the contribution belongs to (foreign key -> sponsor_enrollments).

event_type.meaning: Contribution line type, taken verbatim from the sponsor charter events.

amount.meaning: Contribution amount; postings positive, refunds negative.

contribution_month.meaning: Covered calendar month the contribution pays for.

posted_date.meaning: Date the payroll deduction, direct-bill payment or refund was posted.

contribution_method.meaning: How this line was collected or returned.

original_contribution_id.meaning: For refunds, the posting being returned (foreign key -> sponsor_contributions.contribution_id); empty on postings.

elig_record_id.meaning: Primary id of the eligibility-file line.

enrollment_id.meaning: Enrollment the line applies to (foreign key -> sponsor_enrollments).

customer_id.meaning: Patient named on the line (foreign key -> customers).

event_type.meaning: Eligibility line type, taken verbatim from the sponsor charter events.

change_type.meaning: Change the employer's file reports for this patient.

effective_date.meaning: Effective date the employer states for the change.

file_date.meaning: Date Larkspur received the eligibility file carrying the line.

qle_type.meaning: Qualifying life event behind a mid-year dependent add; none otherwise.

values: Larkspur at Work Virtual Urgent Care
Larkspur at Work Core with Behavioral Health
Larkspur at Work Total Care Plus
new_variant_name.meaning: Plan the group moves to on a plan_change line; empty string otherwise.

incentive_id.meaning: Primary id of the wellness-incentive line.

enrollment_id.meaning: Enrollment earning the incentive (foreign key -> sponsor_enrollments).

event_type.meaning: Incentive line type, taken verbatim from the sponsor charter events.

incentive_date.meaning: Date the incentive was earned, paid or forfeited.

plan_year_start.meaning: Plan year the incentive belongs to.

qualifying_visit_id.meaning: Completed visit that earned the incentive (foreign key -> visit_appointments).

source_incentive_id.meaning: For paid and forfeited lines, the earned line settled (foreign key -> sponsor_incentives.incentive_id); empty on earned lines.

pack_id.meaning: Primary id of the visit pack.

customer_id.meaning: Patient who holds and uses the pack (foreign key -> customers).

variant_name.meaning: Pack held, as the official pack name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the pack (basis defined in the pack charter lifecycle).

expiry_date.meaning: Last day credits may be used for a visit scheduled on that day; moved later by an extension.

credits_remaining.meaning: Credits not yet redeemed; always equals credits purchased and reinstated less credits redeemed, expired and removed.

price_paid.meaning: Amount actually charged for the pack after any member discount, auto-reload discount or upgrade credit.

upgraded_from_pack_id.meaning: For an upgrade purchase, the pack it replaced (foreign key -> pack_holdings.pack_id); empty otherwise.

auto_reload.meaning: Whether a new pack of the same kind is bought automatically when this one runs out.

membership_id.meaning: Membership whose member discount priced the pack (foreign key -> membership_holdings); empty when none applied.

closed_date.meaning: Date the pack became expired, refunded or upgraded; empty otherwise.

pack_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the credit ledger line.

pack_id.meaning: Pack whose credits move (foreign key -> pack_holdings).

event_type.meaning: Credit line type, taken verbatim from the pack charter events.

credits.meaning: Number of credits the line moves; the event type gives the direction (forfeited lines move none and record the credits kept).

visit_id.meaning: Visit the credits were redeemed for, reinstated from or forfeited on (foreign key -> visit_appointments); empty for purchase, expiry and removal lines.

source_entry_id.meaning: For reinstated and forfeited lines, the redemption line they settle (foreign key -> pack_credit_ledger.pack_entry_id); empty otherwise.

pack_payment_id.meaning: Primary id of the pack payment line.

pack_id.meaning: Pack paid or refunded (foreign key -> pack_holdings).

event_type.meaning: Payment line type, taken verbatim from the pack charter events.

refund_basis.meaning: Basis of a refund line; none on charges.

visit_id.meaning: For a post_expiry_credit refund, the visit whose credit could not be reinstated (foreign key -> visit_appointments); empty otherwise.

original_payment_id.meaning: For refunds, the purchase line refunded (foreign key -> pack_payments.pack_payment_id); empty on charges.

visit_id.meaning: Primary id of the visit appointment.

customer_id.meaning: Patient the visit is for (foreign key -> customers).

variant_name.meaning: Visit type booked, as the official visit type name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the visit (basis defined in the visit charter lifecycle); for an Asynchronous Message Consult, scheduled means submitted and awaiting the clinician.

booked_date.meaning: Date the visit was booked (or the consult submitted).

scheduled_start.meaning: Scheduled start of the visit in US Eastern Time; for an Asynchronous Message Consult, the moment it was submitted. Re-stated on every reschedule.

patient_location_state.meaning: State where the patient said they would physically be during the visit, recorded at booking and on every reschedule.

payment_path.meaning: How the visit is paid, set at booking under the visit payment path rule and re-stated if the path changes before the visit.

membership_id.meaning: Membership whose benefit or member price applies (foreign key -> membership_holdings); empty when no membership benefit applies.

enrollment_id.meaning: Larkspur at Work enrollment paying the visit (foreign key -> sponsor_enrollments); empty unless payment_path is sponsor_plan.

coverage_id.meaning: Insurance coverage billed for the visit (foreign key -> insurance_coverages); empty unless payment_path is insurance.

pack_id.meaning: Visit pack whose credit pays the visit (foreign key -> pack_holdings); empty unless payment_path is pack_credit.

clinician_name.meaning: Name of the treating clinician as shown in the app (e.g. 'Marcus Oyelaran, NP').

reschedule_count.meaning: Number of times the visit has been rescheduled.

cancelled_at.meaning: Moment the visit was cancelled, marked a no-show or cancelled by Larkspur, in US Eastern Time; empty otherwise.

completed_date.meaning: Date the clinician signed the visit (or answered the consult); empty until completed.

converted_to_visit_id.meaning: For an Asynchronous Message Consult the clinician converted to a video visit, the video visit booked in its place (foreign key -> visit_appointments.visit_id); empty otherwise.

visit_charge_id.meaning: Primary id of the visit billing line.

event_type.meaning: Billing line type, taken verbatim from the visit charter events.

amount.meaning: Amount of the line charged to the card on file; charges positive, refunds negative. A 0.00 amount is never recorded.

pricing_basis.meaning: Which price the line was computed from; refund on refund lines.

original_charge_id.meaning: For refunds, the line being refunded (foreign key -> visit_charges.visit_charge_id); empty on charges.

refund_reason.meaning: Basis of a refund line; none on charges.

gfe_id.meaning: Primary id of the Good Faith Estimate record.

visit_id.meaning: Visit the estimate covers (foreign key -> visit_appointments).

event_type.meaning: Estimate record type, taken verbatim from the visit charter events.

estimate_amount.meaning: Total expected self-pay charges for the visit stated on the estimate.

issued_date.meaning: Date the estimate was delivered to the patient.

scheduled_start.meaning: Scheduled start the estimate was prepared for; a new estimate is issued when a reschedule changes the expected charges.

fee_review_id.meaning: Primary id of the fee review request.

customer_id.meaning: Patient asking for the review (foreign key -> customers).

visit_id.meaning: Visit whose fee is reviewed (foreign key -> visit_appointments).

visit_charge_id.meaning: Late-cancellation or no-show fee line reviewed (foreign key -> visit_charges).

review_reason.meaning: Ground the patient gives for the review.

review_status.meaning: pending until decided by the billing team; approved reviews end in a refund of the fee line.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

customer_id.meaning: Patient the prescription is written for (foreign key -> customers).

variant_name.meaning: Larkspur Pharmacy formulary level of the drug, as the official level name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the prescription (basis defined in the rx charter lifecycle).

drug_name.meaning: Drug, strength and form exactly as written (e.g. 'atorvastatin 20 mg tablet').

written_date.meaning: Date the clinician signed the prescription.

expiration_date.meaning: Last day the prescription may be filled (written_date plus rx_validity_months, month-end fallback).

days_supply.meaning: Days of medication in one fill as written (30 or 90).

fills_authorized.meaning: Total fills authorized, counted in 30-day fill units, including the first fill.

fills_remaining.meaning: 30-day fill units not yet dispensed; always equals units authorized and returned less units dispensed.

fulfillment.meaning: Where the prescription is filled: Larkspur Pharmacy home delivery or a retail pharmacy the patient named.

external_pharmacy_name.meaning: Name and city of the retail pharmacy the prescription was sent or transferred to, as the patient gave it (e.g. 'CVS Pharmacy, 1420 Beacon St, Brookline'); empty for Larkspur Pharmacy.

prescribing_visit_id.meaning: Visit at which the clinician wrote the prescription (foreign key -> visit_appointments).

renewed_from_rx_id.meaning: For a renewal, the prescription it renews (foreign key -> rx_prescriptions.rx_id); empty otherwise.

auto_refill.meaning: Whether Larkspur Pharmacy ships each refill automatically when it falls due.

insurance_billing.meaning: Whether fills are billed to the patient's pharmacy benefit (true) or sold at the Larkspur Pharmacy cash price (false).

coverage_id.meaning: Insurance coverage whose pharmacy benefit is billed (foreign key -> insurance_coverages); empty for cash fills.

hold_reason.meaning: Why the prescription is on hold; none otherwise.

hold_start_date.meaning: Date the current hold started; empty when not on hold.

transferred_date.meaning: Date the prescription was transferred out; empty otherwise.

rx_fill_id.meaning: Primary id of the fill ledger line.

event_type.meaning: Fill line type, taken verbatim from the rx charter events.

fill_units.meaning: 30-day fill units the line moves (a 90-day fill moves 3); reship lines move none.

fill_date.meaning: Date authorized, dispensed and shipped, returned to stock, or reshipped.

days_supply_dispensed.meaning: Days of medication shipped (30 or 90); 0 on authorization lines.

shipping_speed.meaning: Shipping chosen for the shipment; none on authorization and return lines.

early_override.meaning: Whether the fill used the early-refill override.

source_fill_id.meaning: For returns and reships, the dispensed line concerned (foreign key -> rx_fills.rx_fill_id); empty otherwise.

reship_reason.meaning: Why a fill was reshipped or returned to stock; none otherwise.

rx_charge_id.meaning: Primary id of the pharmacy billing line.

event_type.meaning: Billing line type, taken verbatim from the rx charter events.

amount.meaning: Amount charged to the card on file; charges positive, refunds negative; a 0.00 amount is never recorded.

charge_date.meaning: Date posted (the ship date for fills and shipping).

rx_fill_id.meaning: Dispensed fill line the charge or refund belongs to (foreign key -> rx_fills).

price_basis.meaning: Price the line was computed from.

pbm_patient_pay.meaning: On fills billed to the pharmacy benefit, the patient pay the benefit returned for the fill, recorded even when the lower cash price is charged; 0.00 on cash-only fills, shipping and refunds.

original_charge_id.meaning: For refunds, the line refunded (foreign key -> rx_charges.rx_charge_id); empty on charges.

refund_reason.meaning: Basis of a refund line; none on charges.

rx_request_id.meaning: Primary id of the pharmacy request.

customer_id.meaning: Patient making the request (foreign key -> customers).

rx_fill_id.meaning: For lost-package claims, the dispensed fill concerned (foreign key -> rx_fills); empty otherwise.

target_pharmacy_name.meaning: For transfers, the receiving pharmacy exactly as the patient gave it; empty otherwise.

request_status.meaning: Outcome; pending until decided, denied_visit_required when a renewal needs a visit first.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

lab_order_id.meaning: Primary id of the lab order.

variant_name.meaning: Panel ordered, as the official panel name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the order (basis defined in the lab charter lifecycle).

ordered_date.meaning: Date the clinician placed the order.

ordering_visit_id.meaning: Visit at which the clinician ordered the panel (foreign key -> visit_appointments).

payment_path.meaning: How the panel is paid, set at ordering under the lab payment path rule.

membership_id.meaning: Membership whose benefit or member price applies (foreign key -> membership_holdings); empty otherwise.

enrollment_id.meaning: Larkspur at Work enrollment paying the panel (foreign key -> sponsor_enrollments); empty otherwise.

coverage_id.meaning: Insurance coverage the partner lab bills (foreign key -> insurance_coverages); empty otherwise.

requisition_expiry_date.meaning: Last day the specimen may be collected (or the kit postmarked back) under this order.

kit_shipped_date.meaning: Date the at-home kit shipped; empty otherwise.

collected_date.meaning: Date the specimen was collected (for kits, the collection date written on the kit); empty until collected.

resulted_date.meaning: Date the lab reported results or, for a rejected specimen, the rejection; empty until reported.

reviewed_date.meaning: Date a clinician reviewed the results; empty until reviewed.

rejection_reason.meaning: Why the lab rejected the specimen; none otherwise.

redraw_of_order_id.meaning: For a redraw, the order whose specimen was rejected (foreign key -> lab_orders.lab_order_id); empty otherwise.

cancelled_date.meaning: Date the order was cancelled or expired; empty otherwise.

reissue_count.meaning: Number of times the requisition was reissued with a new expiry date.

lab_charge_id.meaning: Primary id of the lab billing line.

event_type.meaning: Billing line type, taken verbatim from the lab charter events.

amount.meaning: Amount charged to the card on file; charges positive, refunds negative; a 0.00 amount is never recorded.

pricing_basis.meaning: Price the line was computed from.

original_charge_id.meaning: For refunds, the line refunded (foreign key -> lab_charges.lab_charge_id); empty on charges.

refund_reason.meaning: Basis of a refund line; none on charges.

coverage_id.meaning: Primary id of the insurance coverage record.

variant_name.meaning: Plan type of the coverage as Larkspur classifies it, as the official plan type name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the coverage record (basis defined in the claim charter lifecycle).

payer_name.meaning: Health plan issuing the coverage; the six named payers are Larkspur's in-network payers.

member_number.meaning: Member ID exactly as printed on the insurance card (e.g. 'NWH884120577').

group_number.meaning: Group number exactly as printed on the insurance card.

subscriber_relationship.meaning: Patient's relationship to the policy subscriber.

subscriber_date_of_birth.meaning: Subscriber's date of birth as given by the patient (used for the birthday rule).

coverage_order.meaning: Order in which the coverage pays under coordination of benefits.

effective_date.meaning: First day the coverage is in force per the payer.

termination_date.meaning: Last day the coverage is in force per the payer; empty while open-ended.

last_verified_date.meaning: Date of the most recent successful eligibility check; empty if never verified.

plan_grandfathered.meaning: Whether the payer reports the plan as an ACA grandfathered plan (not subject to the no-cost-share preventive rule).

pcp_designated.meaning: Whether the payer lists a Larkspur clinician as the member's primary care provider of record.

telehealth_copay.meaning: Copay for a telehealth office visit from the latest eligibility response; 0.00 when the plan applies deductible and coinsurance instead.

deductible_individual.meaning: Individual in-network deductible for the plan year.

deductible_met.meaning: Amount of the individual deductible met so far this plan year, as last reported by the payer.

coinsurance_pct.meaning: Member coinsurance percent after the deductible.

oop_max.meaning: Individual in-network out-of-pocket maximum for the plan year.

oop_met.meaning: Out-of-pocket spending met so far this plan year, as last reported by the payer.

claim_id.meaning: Primary id of the claim submission.

event_type.meaning: Submission type, taken verbatim from the claim charter events.

visit_id.meaning: Visit the claim bills (foreign key -> visit_appointments).

service_date.meaning: Date of service (the visit's scheduled_start date).

billed_amount.meaning: Charge billed to the payer (the visit type's list price).

submission_date.meaning: Date the claim reached the payer.

original_claim_id.meaning: For a corrected claim, the submission it replaces (foreign key -> insurance_claims.claim_id); empty on originals.

remit_id.meaning: Primary id of the remittance line.

event_type.meaning: Remittance type, taken verbatim from the claim charter events.

allowed_amount.meaning: Amount the payer allowed under its contract; 0.00 on denials.

deductible_applied.meaning: Part of the allowed amount applied to the deductible.

patient_responsibility.meaning: Total the payer assigns to the patient (deductible + copay + coinsurance); 0.00 on denials.

denial_code.meaning: Reason a claim was denied; none on adjudicated claims.

balance_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the patient balance entry.

coverage_id.meaning: Coverage the balance arises under (foreign key -> insurance_coverages).

event_type.meaning: Balance entry type, taken verbatim from the claim charter events.

claim_id.meaning: Claim the entry belongs to (foreign key -> insurance_claims).

visit_id.meaning: Visit of that claim (foreign key -> visit_appointments).

amount.meaning: Signed effect on the patient balance of the claim: amounts owed, credit moved away to another claim and credit refunds positive; time-of-service collections applied, payments, discounts, write-offs and credit received negative.

source_entry_id.meaning: For claim_credit_received, the claim_credit_transferred entry the credit came from (foreign key -> patient_balance_entries.balance_entry_id); empty otherwise.

statement_id.meaning: Primary id of the patient statement.

coverage_id.meaning: Coverage the balance arises under (foreign key -> insurance_coverages).

event_type.meaning: Statement type, taken verbatim from the claim charter events.

claim_id.meaning: Claim billed on the statement (foreign key -> insurance_claims).

statement_number.meaning: Sequence of the statement for this claim balance (1 = first statement).

billing_request_id.meaning: Primary id of the billing request.

claim_id.meaning: Claim concerned (foreign key -> insurance_claims); empty for requests not tied to one claim.

plan_months.meaning: For payment plans, the number of monthly installments; 0 otherwise.

monthly_amount.meaning: For payment plans, the installment amount; 0.00 otherwise.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

referral_id.meaning: Primary id of the in-person care referral.

variant_name.meaning: Referral type, as the official referral type name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the referral (basis defined in the referral charter lifecycle).

referral_date.meaning: Date the clinician issued the referral.

referring_visit_id.meaning: Visit at which the referral was issued (foreign key -> visit_appointments).

specialty.meaning: Specialty or service referred to, as written by the clinician (e.g. 'Dermatology', 'MRI lumbar spine without contrast').

imaging_modality.meaning: Imaging modality for a Diagnostic Imaging Referral; none for other types.

urgency.meaning: Clinical urgency set by the referring clinician.

receiving_provider_name.meaning: Outside provider or facility the patient chose, as the patient or navigator recorded it; empty until chosen.

receiving_in_network.meaning: Whether the receiving provider is in network for the patient's coverage.

coverage_id.meaning: Coverage whose authorization governs the referral (foreign key -> insurance_coverages); empty for self-pay patients.

authorization_number.meaning: Payer authorization number exactly as issued; empty when none.

visits_remaining.meaning: Authorized in-person visits not yet used; always equals visits authorized less visits reported.

valid_through.meaning: Last day the referral (and its authorization) may be used.

appointment_date.meaning: Date of the outside appointment once scheduled; empty before.

reissue_count.meaning: Times an expired referral was reissued.

closed_date.meaning: Date the referral was completed, denied, expired or cancelled; empty while open.

referral_auth_id.meaning: Primary id of the authorization line.

event_type.meaning: Authorization line type, taken verbatim from the referral charter events.

visits.meaning: Visits the line authorizes or uses; 0 on requests and denials.

line_date.meaning: Date of the request, decision or reported visit.

valid_through.meaning: Validity end set by an approval or extension; repeated from the referral otherwise.

reported_visit_date.meaning: For visit reports, the date of the outside visit; empty otherwise.

request_priority.meaning: Priority of an authorization request; standard on other lines.

coordination_id.meaning: Primary id of the coordination record.

event_type.meaning: Coordination record type, taken verbatim from the referral charter events.

contact_number.meaning: For follow-up contacts, the sequence (1, 2); 0 otherwise.

records_scope.meaning: Records sent; none on other records.

verification_id.meaning: Primary id of the identity-verification record; one record per patient (content hash of the customer id).

verified.meaning: Whether identity verification passed; once true it never returns to false.

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: Moment of the most recent verification attempt.

handoff_id.meaning: Primary id of the handoff record (content hash of customer id and reason).

customer_id.meaning: Patient handed off to a human representative (foreign key -> customers).

reason.meaning: Reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
